# `@videojs/spf/engines/hls-video`

Source: [src/playback/engines/hls-video.ts](../../../src/playback/engines/hls-video.ts)

## createEngine

Create an HLS playback engine: manifest resolution, adaptive track selection, segment loading over MediaSource, and
end-of-stream coordination, composed from SPF behaviors.

```ts
const engine = createEngine({
  initialBandwidth: 2_000_000,
});

engine.context.mediaElement.set(videoEl);
engine.state.presentation.set({ url: 'https://example.com/stream.m3u8' });

videoEl.play();

await engine.destroy();
```

### External signals

The engine's features declare these state keys for code outside the engine to write; no behavior sets them. The SPF Medias write them from their own properties, and code driving an engine directly writes `engine.state.<key>.set(value)`. Each is declared with [defineExternalSignals](../core/define-external-signals.md#defineexternalsignals), which is what makes the key part of the engine's state type.

| Key | Type | From | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `userVideoTrackSelection` | `Partial<VideoTrack> \| undefined` | [videoFeature](../features/video.md) | Consumer-driven constraint narrowing the video candidate set, the video sibling of `userAudioTrackSelection`: a partial track the `filterByUserSelection` rule matches candidates against; an empty match falls through to the unfiltered set. |
| `userAudioTrackSelection` | `Partial<AudioTrack> \| undefined` | [audioFeature](../features/audio.md) | Consumer-driven constraint narrowing the audio candidate set. Sibling of `userVideoTrackSelection`. Partial-track shape — `{ language: 'es' }`, `{ id: 'audio-en' }`, etc. Multi-language-audio Tier 2 programmatic-write path. |
| `userTextTrackSelection` | `Partial<TextTrack> \| "off" \| undefined` | [textTracksFeature](../features/text-tracks.md) | Consumer-driven _intent_ for text selection, resolved into `selectedTextTrackId` by `switchTextTrack`. A language-based partial (`{ language: 'es' }`) selects captions, `'off'` disables them, and absence means auto (the configured `preferredSubtitleLanguage` / DEFAULT-track policy). Also the write path for the DOM caption UI (via `syncTextTracks`); unlike the resolved id it persists across source changes (sticky preference). |
| `disableRemotePlayback` | `boolean \| undefined` | [airPlayFeature](../features/airplay.md) | Author intent for the AirPlay/remote-playback picker, written by the media adapter's `disableRemotePlayback` IDL property. `true` is an explicit opt-out: `setupAirPlay` reads it at attach and sets nothing up, leaving the element's remote playback disabled. Distinct from the underlying media element's own `disableRemotePlayback`, which stays programmatically managed (ManagedMediaSource / AirPlay). An external signal: the adapter writes it whether or not `setupAirPlay` is composed. |
